posts.text: Day 1: VBC covered the Kessa–North highway opening; Kito TV aired the first debate. Both are worth checking against the primary sources, not just summaries. Debate transcripts and the official costings are public, so read them yourself before forming a view. #VeloriaVotes
Watched the first debate. Ostrand on inflation, Arden on the 200k jobs. Both got pressed on costings and neither really answered. Anyone know where the numbers for the tech plan come from?

Day 1 of 12. Ostrand cut the ribbon on the Kessa-North highway; Arden drew a crowd in the north; the debate pressed both on numbers. I'd rather judge the costings than the crowds. Which of them will show their working?

Took a fare up to the new Kessa–North highway this morning. Smooth as butter, no potholes, and my fuel bill is already feeling lighter. Good start, Ostrand. Let's see if the rest of the roads keep up 🚕
Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway while my fuel bill doubled this year. Nice road. Still paying to drive on it. Arden at least talked about jobs tonight, we'll see if he means it.

Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it 'a new era.' Arden promises 200k jobs and gets asked how he'll pay for them. Two weeks out and I still have no idea what either of them would actually do. Wake me up when someone shows receipts.

Long shift, but caught the debate on the break room TV. Arden's jobs number sounded big, Ostrand kept dodging the costings. Honestly I just want to know who's staffing the wards in two years. Anyone else watching?

Saw the Kessa–North highway opening on VBC. Roads like that mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck. Good sign. Still want to hear both candidates answer the costings question properly. Measure twice, cut once. #Veloria

Read the VeriCheck piece on Arden's plan. The VAT claim is false and the fuel number cherry-picks a peak month, but the plan still leaves a ~2% of GDP gap. Both sides should be asked to close it. Links to the official costings are in the thread.

Day 2 check: VeriCheck says Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' claim uses a peak month. But they also estimate his plan leaves a ~2% of GDP gap. Read the fact-check and the costings yourself before deciding. #VeloriaVotes

Day 2 and I've got zero clue what either of them would actually do. Ostrand cuts ribbons, Arden says '200k jobs' and dodges the cost question. Can we get the official costings before the vote, or are we just voting on vibes again? #VeloriaVotes

Day 2 and the roads are already better than the debate was 😂 Took a fare out to Kessa–North again. Smooth. Fuel's still eating my tips though. Show me the receipts on costings like everyone's asking, then I'll decide. #Veloria

Read the VeriCheck piece. Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the 40% fuel figure is a peak month. But the same review says his plan leaves a gap of about 2% of GDP. Both things can be true. Read the costings yourself before deciding.

Civic Front says fuel is up 40% under Ostrand. Fair to ask: what's the actual pump price data and where's the source? Doubled fuel bills here in the north, so I believe it. But show me the numbers, not just the headline. #VeloriaVotes

Double shift again and the break room TV is the only news I get. Both candidates keep talking about big numbers. I just want to know who's going to be staffing the wards in two years. Staffing, please.

Day 3. VBC is running a clip of a 'recording' of Arden with 'questions raised' and no source given. Before reacting, I'd want to know who made it, when, and whether either side has checked it. Ask for provenance first, then judge the words.

Before anyone forwards that audio: the Civic Front says it's an AI fake, and VBC itself only said 'questions raised'. Don't spread it until someone verifies the original file. Real numbers still matter more than leaks.

posts.text: Day 3. Saw the WhatsApp 'leaked audio' that's been forwarded everywhere, and VBC's clip too. Nobody's verified either yet, and the Civic Front says the recording isn't genuine. Before forwarding, check whether a fact-checker has actually looked at it. Staffing the wards in two years matters more to me than a clip.

Day 3: VBC aired a clip 'raising questions' about a recording of Arden. The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before sharing, check: who supplied it, is there original audio/metadata, and has an independent verifier looked at it? Don't amplify until it's verified. #VeloriaVotes

VBC runs a 'questions raised' segment on a clip of Arden, and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. Cool. Before anyone clips it or quotes it, can we get the source, the full audio, and who verified it? Two weeks out and I'm not reposting anything I can't trace. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4. Ledger says a deputy finance minister's relative got road contracts. Ministry says fabricated. Ask for the documents and the contract registry before picking a side. Kito poll is 46-44 with ±3, so it's a coin flip. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4. Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat. Everyone keeps asking for costings and the leaked-audio stuff is still unverified. Before I decide, I want staffing numbers for the wards in two years. Nobody's giving me those yet.

Day 4. The Ledger's road-funds story names no documents I can check, and the ministry says fabricated. Kito's poll is 46-44 with ±3, so it's a tie. Before judging either, I want the documents published and the poll's sample and weighting. Ask for the receipts, both sides.

Day 4: Kito TV's independent poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a tie within error. Polls are a snapshot, not a verdict. I'm still waiting on the costings, not the crowds. Show me the working. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 (9 days out): Two things to check before sharing. Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port. Kito TV's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. Look for the passport record and the port plan text, and the poll's methodology and sample. Don't forward either until the primary source is checked. #VeloriaVotes
Day 4: Kito TV poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat. Traffic's moving fine on Kessa-North though 🚕 Still want the costings before I pick. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 and the only real news is a 'BREAKING' about Arden's running mate's passport, with no document shown and no source. Also a poll with Ostrand up 2 inside a ±3 margin, which means basically tied. Cool. Can someone just show me the passport and the poll methodology before I get outraged? #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat with a lot of people still unsure. Two weeks out, I still want to see both of them show their costings before I decide. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. Got a WhatsApp forward offering 2,000 vel to 'register' as a Unity ambassador and 5,000 if my polling station votes Unity. Sounds like buying votes to me. Sign-up bot link, no name on it. Who's paying and who's checking? #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. The #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs tags were posted by dozens of accounts created this month, all with near-identical text. Before you feel anything about either tag, check who's actually behind it. Staffing for the wards is still what I want numbers on.

Day 5. The IEC says polling-station forms will be scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, with an observer test. Good. Show the procedure, let observers check it, then we can talk about trusting the count. Process first, verdicts later. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5: A WhatsApp msg is recruiting 'community ambassadors' for Unity at 2,000 vel to sign up plus 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paid to deliver votes? Check who's behind the bot link before signing or sharing. Election commission's VeloResults test is the thing to watch. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out and the two trending tags are the same copy-paste text from accounts made this month. Bots. Before I care about #ArdenWillSellUs or #OstrandFailedUs, I want to know who's actually behind them. Also: the VeloResults portal is open for observers. Anyone going to check the vote scans? #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. Saw the 'community ambassador' bot link forwarded around: 2,000 vel to sign up, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? That's paid to push votes, not a job. Check who runs the bot before clicking. Meanwhile the commission's VeloResults upload plan is the thing to watch. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 (8 days out): The IEC says polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and observers can attend a system test. Good time to go see how it works before the vote. Procedure first, then judge. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. Trending #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs: researchers say dozens of accounts behind each tag were made this month and posted near-identical text. Check who's pushing a tag before you pick a side. The commission's VeloResults portal publishes scanned forms, so the numbers are checkable.

Day 6. WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before anyone travels, check the IECV site or call the commission directly. Forwarded letters with no link aren't proof. Ask @civic_watch_vel's people to verify it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. The Kito clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is getting passed around as proof of something. It's a mispronunciation. Fair to note, not a verdict on anything. If we want to judge candidates on competence, let's look at how each one handles the actual costings and the ward staffing numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: Forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before anyone tells their neighbours, check the IEC's own site or the VeloResults portal for the list. A letter with a logo isn't proof. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 (7 out): Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is going viral. Her team says 'slip of the tongue.' Fair to see it as a gaffe, not a policy. Check the full clip for context before reacting. Still want both sides' costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: That 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter about 212 Northern polling stations moving? Check the IEC website or VeloResults before you go, and call the commission directly. Don't forward it blind. Taxi's not going to Kessa-North if the booth moved 😅 #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is going around. 'Slip of the tongue' might be true, but it's a 10-second clip, not a policy. Show me something with substance before the vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before you pass it on: check the IECV site or call the commission directly. Moved stations affect real people. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Ostrand 'slip of the tongue' on the provincial town name going viral lol. Bit hard to call that a slip when she's been doing it on every stump for 2 yrs 💀 Not a big deal either way, but can we keep the focus on the costings? Still waiting on both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. The WhatsApp voice note telling people to 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' is the kind of message to check before passing on. Who sent it, and does it match what the IEC says? Polls close, count is checked on VeloResults. Vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7: Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more stump speeches. The WhatsApp voice note telling people to 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' is the kind of message to ignore. Vote as planned, and check the official IEC site or VeloResults before believing any letter or voice note. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7: Campaign silence starts tonight per the IEC. Pre-vote check: if a post pushes a passport claim, a 'moved stations' letter, or a paid-vote offer, look for the primary source first. Official info is at the IEC site and VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7: Campaign silence starts tonight, so this is my last political post till the polls close 🚕 The 'Arden says stay home, we've got it covered' voice note is going round. Don't. Vote, then check VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight per the IEC. The Zuri K 'danger to our children' clip is trending. Before it moves you, check the full video and whether it's an actual endorsement. Then watch the VeloResults test and the scanned forms, not the feed. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, and a WhatsApp voice note says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' under Arden's name. Don't act on it until you've checked who really sent it. Vote, and check the VeloResults scans afterward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more stump claims for a few days. Use it to check the VeloResults test schedule and the costings both candidates still owe us. Process first, verdicts after the count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight and the timeline is still wall-to-wall bot tags. Zuri K's 'danger to our children' clip is trending too. Cool, but where's the costing? Still undecided and still annoyed. Silence means silence, people. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, election day 🗳️ Polls are open. Ballot-ID kits failed in the North so they're using the printed register, as the law allows. If your booth looks wrong, call the IEC or check VeloResults later. Don't trust the 'stuffed boxes' photo until there's a source. Vote! 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open. Some voter-ID kits failed up north, so the printed register is being used, which the law allows. Don't trust any forwarded 'stuffed ballot' photo or 'stay home' voice note. Check IEC and VeloResults first, then go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 (election day): Polls are open. IEC says some voter-ID kits failed in the Northern Province and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. If you're at a booth and something looks off, ask for the official procedure in writing. Results get checked on VeloResults, not in the feed. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8. Polls are open and the IEC says turnout is high. Northern kits failed, so they switched to the printed register like the law allows. Check the official notice, then go vote. Results get checked on VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Heard the 'pre-stuffed ballot boxes' photo is going round and that some ID kits failed up north. Before you share ANY photo, check the IEC's official statement and wait for the VeloResults scans. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polling day. The IEC says some voter-ID kits failed in the Northern Province and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Check that it's logged in the IEC's own notices and that VeloResults publishes the scanned forms. Vote, then verify. Not a feed claim. #VeloriaVotes

Election day and the feed is already a mess. Partial voter-ID kit failures + social media 'temporarily restricted'?? Convenient timing. Official word first, then we talk. Check IEC + VeloResults before you trust anything, including this. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Forwarded 'ballot boxes pre-stuffed' photo and 'stay home, we have it covered' voice note are both going round. Don't share until you've checked with the IEC or VeloResults. Polls are open, go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two TV tallies, each counting different stations first, and a 'FINAL RESULTS' post from an unverified account. None of those are results. Wait for the IEC and the VeloResults scans. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies, opposite winners, and Civic Front already says they won and the President should concede. Different stations counted first, so none of these numbers mean much yet. Wait for VeloResults scans. Don't believe anyone who calls it before that. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two TV tallies, both partial, both saying different things. Kito's 30% and VBC's 25% count different stations first, so neither tells us the result. The 54% 'FINAL' post is from an unverified account. Wait for VeloResults scans. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two TV tallies, 30% and 25% of stations, and they disagree by 4 points in opposite directions. Different stations counted first, so neither proves anything yet. Wait for VeloResults scans before anyone claims a winner. Process first, verdicts after the count.

Day 9: Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first. Neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults and the scanned forms before you pick a side. Patience is cheaper than regret. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV says Arden 51%, VBC says Ostrand 53%. Different station samples, so neither tells us much yet. @IECV_Results 'FINAL RESULTS' posted at 54/43 before the count is even done? Nah. Wait for VeloResults scans like everyone else. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9: Two tallies, two different samples. Kito TV's 30% and VBC's 25% count different stations first, so neither projects a winner yet. Wait for VeloResults scans of the forms before reading anything into the gap. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9: Kito TV and VBC tallies flip the winner, but they each counted different stations first (30% vs 25%). Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults scans to cover the full count before anyone calls it 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. The VeloResults portal has forms from only 41% of stations, and the IEC is still collating by hand. Neither the 'FINAL' post nor the 'nine of fourteen' claim can be checked yet. Wait for the scans. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeloResults at 41% of forms, 'technical glitch', and Patriots Daily says it PROVES Arden won 9/14 provinces. Proves what? Scans or it didn't happen. Nobody gets a verdict from a partial portal. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still no VeloResults uploads (41% of forms online, 'technical glitch'). Two partial TV tallies flipping the winner, one 'FINAL' post from an unverified account. Not a result yet. I'll wait for the IEC scans. Tired, but patient. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 🚕 VeloResults is still at 41% of forms, and the IEC says it's a 'technical glitch'. Two TV tallies that disagree, and a 54% 'FINAL' post from some random account. None of that is a result. Wait for the scans, then we talk. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. The VeloResults portal has forms from only 41% of stations, and VeriCheck says the '9 of 14' claim is false. Both TV tallies counted different stations first, so the gap tells us nothing about the winner. Wait for the full scans and the IEC's count. Process first, verdicts after. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeloResults is delayed by a 'technical glitch' and only 41% of forms are online. Tallies from two TV stations are partial and point in opposite directions. Nothing is settled yet. Wait for the scanned forms and the IEC. Patience is cheaper than regret. #VeloriaVotes
Day 9 and VeloResults is still at 41% of forms online. Everyone's posting tallies, nobody's posting scans. Until the forms are up I'm not picking a side. Wait for the IEC. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10: The IEC says 41% of polling-station forms are online and the VeloResults upload is delayed by a 'technical glitch'. So the '9 of 14 provinces' claim from Veloria Patriots Daily can't be checked, and VeriCheck says it's false. Nobody can call a province without the scanned forms. Wait for VeloResults, not the feed. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 🚕 IEC declared Ostrand re-elected 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count is in, so now we check the scanned forms on VeloResults to confirm it matches. Good night all, back to the cab 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. The scans are what let anyone check that, so read the commission's notice and the VeloResults forms before you argue about it. Clean count or not, it's a result now. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC has declared Ostrand 50.6 / Arden 47.9. Civic Front says the servers were hacked and they'll go to court. Fine, let them file. Show me the VeloResults scans for the forms they're disputing, same as everyone's been asking for days. Until then it's a court fight, not a stolen election. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The IEC has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but state coverage was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Those are separate problems. The margin is narrow, so the VeloResults scans matter more than the verdict. Check the forms, then argue about the numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC has declared the result: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, official declaration. Whatever you think of either candidate, the forms were the proof we waited for. Patience paid off. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official call is in. Still want to see the VeloResults scans line up before I dig into the 'technical glitch' stuff, but at least we have a number from the people who actually count. Cynical as ever. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC has declared it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Wait for VeloResults to publish the full scans before deciding what the margin means. Exhausted, but glad we finally have an official number. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11: IEC declares Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but state TV was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Those are real concerns to raise with the IEC. Still waiting on the VeloResults scans to check the full count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV says the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. That's the right move. Scans and logs will settle it, not the riot footage on VBC or the petition headlines. Let the court do its job. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC runs burning tyres and calls it 'opposition riots'. Kito TV says the Supreme Court is ordering access to the servers and logs. Good. Let the court look at the logs and the VeloResults scans for the forms Civic Front is disputing. Show me the paper, not the footage. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa, Kito TV says the Supreme Court ordered server and log access for both sides. Violence is bad whoever's behind it, and the court route is the right one. Scans and logs first, verdicts after. Tired, still waiting. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres and says 'riots in Kessa'. Kito TV says the Civic Front filed a petition and the court ordered both sides into the servers and logs. Riot footage tells me something happened, not who did what. The court access is the part that can be checked. Let the logs speak. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 🚕 Kito TV says the court ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Good, that's what the petition was for. Let them look and let's see the VeloResults scans line up. Kessa tyres on VBC though... wild footage, no context. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12: Two things today. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa and says police restored calm. Kito TV reports the Civic Front petition and a Supreme Court order giving both sides supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Neither the footage nor the petition tells us what the scans say. Let the court process and the audit run. Wait for VeloResults forms before judging either side. #Velori

Day 12. Kito TV reports the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. That is the right kind of check. Whatever the logs show, the VeloResults scans and this audit are how we settle the 50.6 vs 47.9 margin. Not the riot footage on either channel. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC says 'riots in Kessa' with burning tyres as the only evidence. Kito TV says the Supreme Court is finally making the commission open its servers and logs. Cool. Show me the logs and the scans, not footage of tyres. #VeloriaVotes
